what.en: The street address of the premises where the sign is erected (the store) itself, with suite or unit. Not a mailing, head-office or overseas address, and not a P.O. box. Street line only.
what.zh: 填写招牌安装所在的经营场所（即门店）本身的街道地址（含门牌号/单元号）。不能填写邮寄地址、总部地址、海外地址或邮政信箱。此处只填街道部分。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: the sign is being erected and or maintained at the above location with the permission of the owner
Sign permits are completely and entirely non-transferrable (ex: location to location, sign to sign, wall to wall).
The proposed location is wholly contained on private property

what.en: City, state and ZIP of the premises where the sign is erected.
what.zh: 招牌安装所在场所的城市、州和邮编。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: the sign is being erected and or maintained at the above location with the permission of the owner
Sign permits are completely and entirely non-transferrable (ex: location to location, sign to sign, wall to wall).
The proposed location is wholly contained on private property

what.en: Where the city mails the yearly sign operating permit invoice; the sign owner must keep it current. The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 市政府邮寄年度招牌运营许可账单的地址，招牌所有人须保持其更新。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Use a US address where mail is reliably picked up (the store once leased, or a US office or agent). Placetta asks the agency before using an address abroad.
ifNone.zh: 请使用能可靠收件的美国地址（租下门店后的门店地址，或美国办公室、代理人地址）。如需使用境外地址，Placetta 会先向该机构确认。

confirmations.quote: Thirty (30) days prior to the renewal date, an invoice will be mailed to the billing address listed on the application.

what.en: City, state and ZIP of the billing address. The line has no country field. The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 账单地址的城市、州和邮编。此栏没有国家一项。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Use a US address where mail is reliably picked up (the store once leased, or a US office or agent). Placetta asks the agency before using an address abroad.
ifNone.zh: 请使用能可靠收件的美国地址（租下门店后的门店地址，或美国办公室、代理人地址）。如需使用境外地址，Placetta 会先向该机构确认。

confirmations.quote: Thirty (30) days prior to the renewal date, an invoice will be mailed to the billing address listed on the application.

what.en: The office address of the applicant company (normally the sign contractor). The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 申请公司（通常为招牌承包商）的办公地址。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Use the sign company's own US office address; a Houston-licensed sign contractor will have one. Placetta asks Sign Administration before entering an address abroad.
ifNone.zh: 请填写招牌公司自己的美国办公地址，持有休斯顿执照的招牌承包商都有此地址。如需填写境外地址，Placetta 会先向招牌管理处确认。

what.en: City, state and ZIP of the applicant company's office. The line has no country field. The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 申请公司办公地址的城市、州和邮编。此栏没有国家一项。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Use the sign company's own US office address; a Houston-licensed sign contractor will have one. Placetta asks Sign Administration before entering an address abroad.
ifNone.zh: 请填写招牌公司自己的美国办公地址，持有休斯顿执照的招牌承包商都有此地址。如需填写境外地址，Placetta 会先向招牌管理处确认。
